name: Groundwork Denver Green Teams
what_you_do: Join a paid crew. You work on community gardens, rain barrels and local projects for fair treatment of the earth and its people in Denver neighborhoods.
who_can_apply: Best for ages 14 to 17. Returning youth ages 18 to 21 can take lead roles. The page says the group hires from nearby areas. They include Westwood, Sheridan, NE Park Hill, southern Commerce City, Montbello and NW Aurora.
pay_detail: Paid staff positions. The wage is not stated on the page.
duration: Seasonal. Some teams are summer only, some run in the school year.
deadline_text: Openings change. The page links to a current youth jobs list, last updated 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the "Current Youth Job Openings" link on the Youth Pathways page.
notes: The website moved from groundworkdenver.org to groundworkcolorado.org. The page also lists a GRIT program for ages 18 to 29, which is not for teens.
